mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 8.0% (UNRATE > 8.0%) signals weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0%), or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show growth, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), stable price levels support sustained corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 95.0) signals expanding manufacturing output, increasing corporate earnings potential and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 1.0% annualized (computed from GDPC1) indicates strong economic expansion, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 1.0% annualized, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising employment (PAYEMS > 132,000 thousand) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 8.0%) signals a strengthening labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 132,000 and UNRATE < 8.0%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession housing recovery (HOUST > 650 thousand units), rising home construction activity drives consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 650 thousand, or the signal's Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.
